name: Olealkonium chloride
description: Olealkonium chloride (CAS 37139-99-4 ), also supplied under the trade names Rhodaquat 7LUF and Cycloton 7LUF and recognized commercially as Benzyldimethyloleylammonium chloride, is a quaternary ammonium compound used across personal care, cleaning, and industrial markets. Its primary functions are antimicrobial preservation, surface modification, and emulsification in formulated products. In personal care, it acts as a conditioning agent and preservative booster in rinse-off and leave-on formulations. It is particularly effective in hair conditioners and skin creams. Industrial and institutional cleaning products rely on it as an active biocide against bacteria and fungi, where it delivers broad-spectrum efficacy at low use levels. Textile processors apply it as a softening and antistatic agent during fiber finishing, improving handle and reducing static charge in synthetic fabrics. This versatility makes it a staple in large-scale manufacturing environments. In leather and paper manufacturing, it functions as a surface-active treatment agent to improve wetting, penetration, and uniformity of processing baths. This ensures consistent quality across various industrial substrates and materials. Olealkonium chloride is typically supplied as a liquid solution, with active content concentrations commonly ranging from 50% to 80%. Technical-grade material is the standard offering for industrial and cleaning applications. Personal care grades are available to meet cosmetic formulation requirements and safety standards.
